text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israel's High Court to rule today on petitions against Netanyahu, Justice Minister Hanegbi in Bar-On affair.
- Israeli woman moderately wounded in shooting ambush by terrorists.
- Confrontation between settlers and Palestinian police in Gaza Strip.
- Israel to transfer to Jordan $50 million of its annual U.S. aid over next five years.
- Soldier hurt in south Lebanon security zone.
- Coalition rift with Israel Ba-Aliyah immigrant party expected to be resolved soon.
- Netanyahu has decided on free market for foreign currency.
- Unrest in Hebron, one woman wounded in ambush near Jerusalem.
- Officials in Jerusalem tense ahead of High Court decision on Bar-On petitions.
- Police to question Labour party legislator Nissim Zvilli in connection with Gregory Lerner case.
- Netanyahu has decided to appoint reserve Brigadier-General Gadi Zohar as military secretary.
